query: db.meters.aggregate([ { $setWindowFields: { sortBy: { "year": 1 }, output: { moving_avg: { $avg: "$peak_load", window: { documents: [-2, 0] } } } } }, { $match: { $expr: { $gt: ["$peak_load", { $multiply: ["$moving_avg", 0.8] }] } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, city: 1, peak_load: "$peak_load", moving_avg: 1 } }])

db.meters.aggregate([ { $setWindowFields: { sortBy: { "year": 1 }, output: { moving_avg: { $avg: "$peak_load", window: { documents: [0, 0] } } } } }, { $match: { $expr: { $gt: ["$peak_load", { $multiply: ["$moving_avg", 1.25] }] } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, city: 1, peak_load: "$peak_load", moving_avg: 1 } }])
